You will collaborate with marketing leaders and cross-functional teams to define key performance metrics, establish analytics frameworks, and drive optimization in marketing strategies. Tech. or equivalent) and MBA from a reputed institute in a relevant field. 2-6 years of professional experience in analytics, data science, or consumer insights roles. title: Mergers and Acquisitions
jobDescription: About the Opportunity Role: Mergers and Acquisitions Level: Deputy Manager Reporting To: Associate Vice President - Investor Relations Location: Gurgaon About the Function: The Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) function at MakeMyTrip serves as a strategic growth driver by identifying, evaluating, and executing investment, acquisition, and partnership opportunities that align with the company’s long-term vision. The team conducts market scanning, sector research, financial modeling, valuation analysis, and due diligence to assess strategic fit and financial viability, while collaborating closely with business, finance, legal, and leadership stakeholders to structure and execute transactions. Post-transaction, the M&A function supports integration and monitors portfolio performance to ensure sustainable value creation and disciplined capital allocation. About the Role: The role within the M&A function involves driving end-to-end investment evaluation and execution by conducting market research, identifying potential acquisition or investment targets, building detailed financial models, and preparing investment memorandums for leadership review. It includes supporting due diligence, valuation analysis, deal structuring, and transaction execution while collaborating with cross-functional teams to assess strategic fit and risks. The role also extends to post-investment monitoring, working closely with portfolio companies and internal stakeholders to track performance and ensure long-term value creation aligned with the organization’s growth strategy. What will you be doing: Conduct market scanning to identify potential domestic and international investment/acquisition opportunities. Perform in-depth sector research, including value drivers, risks, competitive landscape, global benchmarks, and valuation multiples. Drive deal origination by building strong relationships across the startup and investor ecosystem (entrepreneurs, VCs, bankers, incubators, accelerators). Build financial models and prepare Investment Committee notes and investment memorandums. Support the full investment lifecycle — sourcing, valuation, due diligence, deal structuring, execution, and integration. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to evaluate strategic fit, financial viability, and transaction risks, and present recommendations to leadership. Monitor post-investment performance and work closely with portfolio companies to drive value creation. Partner with leadership to refine organizational strategy and evaluate organic and inorganic growth opportunities. Conduct competitive benchmarking and ongoing market intelligence analysis. Qualification & Experience: MBA / CA / CFA with 5–6 years of experience in M&A, corporate development, investment banking, or transaction advisory roles. Strong expertise in financial modeling, valuation (DCF, comparable multiples, transaction comps), and due diligence processes. Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to build detailed financial models and create high-quality Investment Committee presentations. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating with leadership, external advisors, and cross-functional teams during deal execution. Key Success Factors for the Role: Deep understanding of financials and key cost line items with strong business orientation. High ownership mindset with the initiative to proactively pick up and drive assignments. Ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional team environment. Strong analytical orientation with a structured problem-solving approach. Ability to create clear, crisp, and insight-led presentations for senior stakeholders.

title: Product Analyst (Ground Transport)

From personalized recommendations to conversational booking journeys, automated customer assistance and real-time decision systems, we are building the next generation of travel experiences at scale. In this role, you will convert product and user journey data into clear insights that help Product Managers validate decisions, measure launches, and shape the roadmap. The Product Analyst will help the business make better product decisions through data, experimentation, and scalable insight systems. This role will own product performance tracking, support discovery and launch analysis, and build AI-enabled workflows and self-serve analytics tools that reduce dependency on manual requests. The analyst will partner with Product, Data, and Technology teams to turn product questions into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable recommendations. What you'll be doing: Build AI-enabled tooling and self-serve workflows Id entify recurring manual analysis requests and convert them into dashboards, templates, automated reports, or AI-assisted workflows. Use AI tools to accelerate insight generation, anomaly detection, workflow documentation, and stakeholder-ready summaries. Partner with data science, product, and technology teams to build a self-serve platform that lets stakeholders answer common product questions independently. Maintain metric definitions, reusable query logic, and documentation so self-serve outputs remain trusted and consistent. Support product discovery and experimentation Partner with Product Managers to frame hypotheses, size opportunities, and evaluate product ideas using data. Design and analyze experiments, A/B tests, cohort cuts, and pre/post launch reads to guide roadmap decisions. Create clear readouts that connect analysis to customer impact, business impact, and next actions. Bridge product, data, and technology teams Translate business and product questions into clear analytical requirements, tracking needs, and data definitions. Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve event instrumentation, reporting reliability, and analytical coverage. Create structured product insights for leadership reviews, roadmap discussions, and launch retrospectives. Drive product performance visibility Define success metrics for product launches, feature adoption, funnel movement, engagement, conversion, and retention. Build dashboards and insight narratives that help product and leadership teams understand what is working, what is not, and where to focus next. Identify trends, anomalies, and user journey friction from product data, then translate findings into practical recommendations. Qualification & Experience: 1-3 years of experience in product analytics, business analytics, data analytics, BI, or a related product-facing role. Strong SQL and Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar visualization tools. Comfort with product metrics, funnels, cohorts, experiments, and translating analysis into clear business recommendations. Exposure to AI tools, workflow automation, no-code or low-code tools, Python, or analytics engineering is a plus. Strong communication skills and the ability to work with Product, Data, Engineering, Growth, and business stakeholders. Key success factors for the role: Success in this role means turning product and user data into clear insights that improve roadmap decisions, feature performance, and customer journeys. The Product Analyst should build trusted dashboards, metrics, and AI-enabled self-serve workflows, while collaborating with the Data Science team on analysis, experimentation, and insight generation. Strong partnership with Product, Data, Technology, and Data Science teams will be key to translating business questions into scalable analytics solutions.
